name: Barbe-Yeux
storyline: Barbe-Yeux, a pirate captain convinced he is a legend, dreams of becoming the richest pirate in the world. He sets out in search of a lost Mayan treasure, accompanied by two companions whose entire vocabulary consists of the word "Gloubi". Their journey takes them across the islands, jungles and ports of the Caribbean, over six chapters.
summary: Barbe-Yeux is a single-player comedic narrative adventure set in a pirate world. Players follow a self-proclaimed legendary captain and his two companions on a treasure hunt, exploring islands, meeting eccentric characters and taking part in story-driven minigames. The game combines absurd humour, dialogue, exploration and party-based combat.
